title: Oscar and the Songbook
author: Y. M. Ashgrove
blurb: Lena Eriksen, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the bakery lease runs out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
